title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah 45a with a halakhic statement, after which Rav Chisda says: “Come and hear.”[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Niddah45a scalar names Rav Chiyya son of Rav Ika raising a challenge. The subsequent Rav Chisda Come and hear statement remains Hyman’s explicit sequence; that continuation is not in the selected scalar and is not falsely described as independently checked here. Full Rav titles remain, and ת״ש is rendered Come and hear.
